statement: The function returns a result r. Let n = len(hats). Let C be the number of functions f from {0, ..., n-1} to {1, ..., 40} such that for every i with 0 <= i < n, f(i) occurs in hats[i] (that is, there exists j with 0 <= j < len(hats[i]) and hats[i][j] = f(i)), and for every i and k with 0 <= i < k < n, f(i) != f(k). Then r = C mod 1000000007.
